title: Ae ghaazi mere bhayya abbas
body:
Ae ghaazi mere bhayya abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
saqqaye sakina, pyaasi hai sakina
<<MINI>>
Ae ghaazi mere bhayya abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
bacho'n ki bujhaado aakar pyaas
<<MINI>>
Ae ghaazi mere bhayya abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
1) Jab qaime lagaye darya par, seraab hua saara lashkar
qabze me tumhaare hai darya, bacho ki bandhi hai tujh se aas
<<MINI>>
Ae ghaazi mere bhayya abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
2) As'haab-e-hussaini kehte hai, saalaar ho tum is lashkar ke
har waqt jaha'n me saaya figan, hai tera pharaira ae abbas
<<MINI>>
Ae ghaazi mere bhayya abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
3) Aaya jo labe darya saqqa, chaaya hua ek tha sannaata
mashkeeze me paani aayega, qaime me sakina ko hai yaas
<<MINI>>
Ae ghaazi mere bhayya abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
4) paani jo bhara mashkeeze mme , thi jaane jari mashkeeze me
jab teer laga mashkeeze me, bas toot gayi saqqe ki aas
<<MINI>>
Ae ghaazi mere bhayya abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
5) Sheh kehte the paani aata hai, ammu tara paani laata hai
bacho ko dilaasa deti hai, masoom sakina ae abbas
<<MINI>>
Ae ghaazi mere bhayya abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
6) Aai ye sada ran se moula, Abbas hua ab tujh pe fida
Pohnche jo shahedee'n laashe par, ho kaise bayaa'n wo hasrato yaas
<<MINI>>
Ae ghaazi mere bhayya abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
7) Aaya hai alam jo qoo'n me bhara, lipta hua sookha mashkeeza
ab koun sambhaale pyaso ko, ab toot gayi bacho ki aas
<<MINI>>
Ae ghaazi mere bhayya abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
8) Hyder tha museebat ka manzar, thaame hai shahedee'n tooti kamar
jab aayi sakina laashe par, tadpa hai tera laasha abbas
<<MINI>>
Ae ghaazi mere bhayya abbas
